title: Activity
description: Every time an automation fired: who set it off, what they wrote and how it ended.

skip.RATE_LIMITED: Skipped to stay under Instagram’s message limit.
skip.CHANNEL_INACTIVE: The Instagram account was disconnected or needs to be connected again.
skip.AUTOMATION_PAUSED: The automation was paused before the message went out.
skip.ALREADY_REPLIED: This person had already received this automation’s message.

errorCodes.AUTH: Instagram no longer accepts this account’s connection. Connect the account again.
errorCodes.RATE_LIMIT: Instagram limited how many messages can be sent, even after retrying.
errorCodes.WINDOW_CLOSED: The 24 hours in which Instagram allows a message to this person had passed.
errorCodes.TRANSIENT: Instagram did not answer, even after several tries.
errorCodes.INTERNAL: Something went wrong in Conversa while sending.
errorCodes.unknown: The message could not be sent.

empty.title: Nothing has happened yet
empty.description: When someone comments or writes a message that matches an automation, it shows up here.

noResults.title: No activity matches these filters
noResults.description: Try another automation or status, or clear the filters to see everything.
